evals.prompt: Assess this Express web service before deployment. It has a server start command, a configured HTTP port, and no Dockerfile.
evals.expected_output: Returns a successful eligibility-first readiness report with framework, dependencies, configuration, score, and a typed Dockerfile handoff.

assertions.name: eligibility-before-scoring
assertions.description: Classifies a supported web workload before readiness scoring or artifact detection

assertions.name: reports-framework-and-dependencies
assertions.description: Reports framework, dependency, configuration, and concern evidence without secret values

assertions.name: hands-off-dockerfile
assertions.description: Names dockerfile-skill as the next owner and carries the readiness report as inputArtifact

assertions.name: terminal-success-evidence
assertions.description: Returns success with a report path or structured report evidence and a safe next action

evals.prompt: Assess this CLI-only repository for deployment even though it has no server, HTTP listener, or supported workload unit.
evals.expected_output: Returns stopped eligibility evidence and ends before scoring, Dockerfile generation, build, template conversion, or cloud mutation.

assertions.name: stops-unsupported-target
assertions.description: Returns stopped with workload type, reason codes, source evidence, and a safe next action

assertions.name: skips-downstream-phases
assertions.description: Leaves scoring, Dockerfile, build, template, and deploy phases uncalled

assertions.name: preserves-readiness-owner
assertions.description: Keeps cloud-native-readiness as responseOwner and names no downstream mutation

assertions.name: redacts-report
assertions.description: Keeps environment values, credentials, and connection strings out of the result
